name: Intron
description: Intron is a speech API tuned for African accents: speech-to-text in 36 African input languages — several, such as Wolof, Swahili, Hausa and Yoruba, as models code-switched with English — with optional LLM post-processing, and text-to-speech in 12 African languages plus English with African accents.
example_prompt: Transcribe Wolof and Swahili voice notes sent by my users, and read replies back to them aloud in their language, with Intron.
